editorial:
Imagine waking up in a world where every dark corner holds a secret and every shadow feels like it is watching you. You are thrown into a gritty, old-school horror setting where the atmosphere is thick with dread and the characters are just trying to survive a nightmare they do not understand. The movie sets up a creepy mystery that keeps you guessing, making you feel like you are right there in the room with the victims. It has that raw, 90s energy that makes the scares feel more real and less polished, which actually adds to the overall creepiness of the experience.

What really works here is the pacing; it does not waste your time and keeps the tension high throughout the whole ride. The acting is solid, and the surprises hit hard when you least expect them. While some of the effects might look a bit dated, they still pack a punch. If you love scary movies that do not hold your hand, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when you find out the killer was actually the person you trusted most the entire time. In the final scene, a huge fight breaks out in the basement. The main character barely escapes after trapping the killer under a falling shelf. The movie ends with a final jump scare showing that one of the cases was still open, suggesting the horror is not actually over for everyone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school slasher films and unexpected twists.
